encoding.address_encoding: UTF-8 bytes of the exact address string
encoding.canonical_json: vector JSON is UTF-8, 2-space indentation, sorted object keys, newline terminated; JSON is transport only, never cryptographic input
encoding.delete: remove the keyed leaf; the resulting path uses empty-subtree hashes
encoding.duplicate_account: a sequential operation on an existing address is an update; a static account set must not contain duplicate addresses
encoding.duplicate_key: reject if different addresses hash to the same key; same-address update replaces the prior leaf
encoding.inclusion: leaf hash is the account leaf and reconstructed root equals expected root
encoding.leaf_fields: version_u8 || key_32 || address_len_u32_be || address_utf8 || balance_u64_be || nonce_u64_be
encoding.level_convention: level 256 is leaf; level 0 is root
encoding.non_inclusion: leaf hash is empty_leaf_hash and reconstructed root equals expected root; no neighbor leaf is required
encoding.proof_encoding: queried key + leaf hash + 256 sibling hashes root-to-leaf + 256 direction bits
encoding.root_encoding: 32 raw bytes represented as lowercase hexadecimal in vectors

purpose: Build 2A frozen candidate SMT cryptographic/reference vectors; no production activation

vectors.name: non_inclusion_proofs
vectors.rule: non-inclusion is proven by an empty leaf at the queried 256-bit key and its 256 sibling hashes; no neighboring leaf is required
